text:
maria: Heads-up — bringing up sirocco-8b on runtime v2.5. Quick smoke shows KV cache drifting on long prompts (>1024). Repro attached below, anyone seen this pattern before?

aj: Can you paste the model config (rotary freq, rope scaling) and quant type?

maria: model config: rotary_freq=32, rope_scaling=linear(1.0->0.9), qtype=q4_0. Runtime auto-picked q3_k kernel for conv path. Repro command: `./run_smoke.sh --model sirocco-8b --seq 2048 --batch 1`
Generation starts fine then diverges around token 2 with kv_index mismatch in logs. Log excerpt:```[ERROR] kv_cache: index mismatch expected=1024 got=1008 (step=120)
[WARN] rotary: sin_cos dims mismatch model_cfg.rotary_freq=32 runtime_freq=64
[DEBUG] quant: kernel=q3_k selected but qtype=q4_0 on disk```

kevin: That error looks like we've got different packing/stride assumptions. We saw something similar when model repo used packed sin/cos layout. Can you dump first 16 sin_cos values from checkpoint?

maria: dumped to /tmp/sirocco/sin_cos_dump.txt — first 8 lines: `0.0000, 0.9987, 0.0491, 0.9988, 0.0980, 0.995, 0.1467, 0.989` etc. Also seeing the runtime report `rotary_freq=64` in the tensor metadata when loading into kernel.

sasha: Try forcing runtime to use rotary_freq=32: `REDWOOD_ROPE_FREQ=32 ./run_smoke.sh` and also force kv stride: `--kv_stride=16`. If that fixes alignment, it's a runtime autodetect bug.

ci-bot: build triggered: runtime/v2.5-rotary-compat-check (#2407) — CI will run unit + smoke.

aj: If forcing fixes it, likely mismatch during model conversion/quantize step (metadata not preserved) or endianness/packing in the quant kernel. Also possibility: our kernel expects sin_cos interleaved vs contiguous.

maria: I can repro locally with forced ENV and confirm. I'll also try quantize on CPU (q4_0) and re-run inference to see if kernel selection differs. Expected perf delta ~2-4% but correctness is the blocker right now.

kevin: I'll prepare a minimal unit test that loads the checkpoint's sin_cos and the runtime loader and asserts shape/ordering. If it fails, we can narrow to loader vs kernel. :thumbsup:

sasha: Quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce on latest runtime build (CI), 2) force rotary params to isolate autodetect, 3) compare kv indices step-by-step, 4) run quantized inference on CPU vs GPU, 5) token-level diff to identify first divergence. I can own 1-3 today.

maria: Thanks. I'm opening a ticket INC-2321 and will attach trimmed repro + model artifact + logs. Will ping here when I have the failing unit test and the CPU quant run.

aj: Sounds good. If you hit a kernel-level bug, assign to eng-runtime and cc me.

kevin: I'll look into kernel packing assumptions after CI finishes.

sasha: Also note: if rope_scaling is non-1.0 we should verify our runtime applies the same schedule — we've had small numeric diffs from inconsistent scaling before.

maria: noted. adding rope_scaling config to ticket. Thanks all.

aj: ping when you have the unit test failing.
